description: Basal aerobic growth on glucose minimal media: biomass yield Yxs (gDW per g glucose). Measured values are the grade target; theoretical_max rows are first-principles ceilings.
Basal aerobic exponential growth rate mu (1/h) on glucose minimal media.
Basal aerobic specific glucose uptake rate q_glc (mmol/gDW/h) on glucose minimal media. With growth_rate and biomass_yield, two of these three are independent (Yxs = mu / (q_glc * M_glc)).

Basal aerobic central-carbon intracellular reaction fluxes (per-reaction vector, 13C-MFA). Each row carries absolute value and value_relative_pct (normalized to glucose uptake). One row per (source, reaction, timepoint).
